{{Top|leg}}
The '''War Cabinet''' was the highest ruling body in the militarized government of [[Alanciar]], a continent on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kesh/Legends|Kesh]]. The War Cabinet was formed after the [[Keshiri/Legends|Keshiri]] [[Gender/Legends|woman]] [[Adari Vaal]] visited Alanciar and warned its inhabitants, the [[Alanciari]], of the threat posed by the [[Lost Tribe of Sith]], a group who lived on the continent of [[Keshtah Minor|Keshtah]] to the west. By the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[invasion of Alanciar]], the War Cabinet had moved their operations to [[Vaal Hall]], a headquarters in the [[City/Legends|city]] [[Sus'mintri]]. During that conflict, the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Korsin Bentado]] stormed Vaal Hall with his [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] forces and slaughtered the members of the War Cabinet so that he could impersonate them.
